text: This is a good dental clinic. I've been here many times for teeth cleaning; they pay attention to detail. I also bring my children for checkups every 6 months. My children aren't afraid of the dentist at all; they say the dentist is kind and not scary.

I took my children and grandchildren to the dentist for fluoride treatment and dental scaling. The dentist was very kind. The children said the dentist had a gentle touch. See you again in 6 months for a dental checkup.
I came for a dental cleaning, tartar removal, and fillings. The dentist was very gentle; it didn't hurt at all. I'll bring my friends along too!

This is a well-maintained clinic. They pay attention to detail. If you make an appointment in advance, you don't have to wait long. The doctor is polite and kind, and the staff are lovely. I had my teeth whitened here before my wedding – and wow, they're beautifully white! I received good advice, and my teeth look great for a long time.
